# mvstmt: hasBreak with break inside if/else in switch case
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int) {
	// BEGIN
	switch x {
	case 1:
		if x > 0 {
			println(x)
		} else {
			break
		}
		println("done")
	default:
		println("default")
	}
	// END
}
